description_en: You can query push records with pagination and basic filtering
description_zh: 分页查询推送记录，并提供一些简单的筛选能力
name: QueryPushRecords

parameters.help_en: The start time for the query. Specify the time in UTC, using the ISO-8601 format `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`
parameters.help_zh: 查询的起始时间，UTC时间，ISO-8601格式，格式为YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time for the query. Specify the time in UTC, using the ISO-8601 format `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`
parameters.help_zh: 查询的结束时间，UTC时间，ISO-8601格式，格式为YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The push type. Valid values:

MESSAGE: A message.

NOTICE: A notification.

LIVE_ACTIVITY: A Live Activity
parameters.help_zh:
推送类型。取值：

MESSAGE：表示消息。

NOTICE：表示通知。

LIVE_ACTIVITY: 表示灵动岛
parameters.name: push_type

parameters.help_en:
The push target. Valid values:

DEVICE: Push to devices.

ACCOUNT: Push to accounts.

ALIAS: Push to aliases.

TAG: Push to tags.

ALL: Push to all devices.

TBD: Initializes a continuous push. The push target is specified in a subsequent call to the `ContinuouslyPush` API operation
parameters.help_zh:
推送目标：

DEVICE：根据设备推送。

ACCOUNT：根据账号推送。

ALIAS：根据别名推送。

TAG：根据标签推送。

ALL：推送给全部设备。

TBD：初始化持续推送，推送目标由后续的ContinuouslyPush接口指定
parameters.name: target

parameters.help_en:
The push source. Valid values:

API: Pushes initiated via an OpenAPI call.

CONSOLE: Pushes initiated from the Mobile Push console.

OpenAPIExplorer: Pushes initiated from Alibaba Cloud OpenAPI Explorer
parameters.help_zh:
推送来源。可取值：

API：OpenAPI发起的推送，含OpenAPI平台控制台发起的推送。
CONSOLE：通过移动推送控制台推送。
OpenAPIExplorer：通过阿里云OpenAPI Explorer平台推送
parameters.name: source

parameters.help_en: The keyword used for the query. The search covers the `MessageId`, `Title`, and `Body` fields. For `Title` and `Body`, the system applies Chinese word segmentation and matches whole tokens instead of substrings
parameters.help_zh: 查询关键字，根据MessageId、Title、Body字段进行查询。系统对推送的title和body进行了中文分词，使用分词进行查询，非子字符串匹配查询
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default: 20. Maximum: 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页的条目数量，默认值为20, 最大为100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number to query. Default: 1. Maximum: 10,000
parameters.help_zh: 推送记录的当前页数, 默认为1，最大10000
parameters.name: page

NextToken.description_en: Deprecated. This parameter is no longer used

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

PushInfo.description_en: The details of a specific notification or message

DeviceType.description_en:
The device type. Valid values:

ALL: All device types.

iOS: iOS devices.

Android: Android devices
DeviceType.description_zh:
设备类型。取值：

ALL：所有类型。

IOS：iOS设备。

ANDROID：Android设备

PushTime.description_en: The UTC time when the push was sent, in ISO 8601 format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
PushTime.description_zh: 推送时间，UTC时间，ISO-8601格式, 格式为 YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ

PushType.description_en:
The push type. Valid values:

MESSAGE: A message.

NOTICE: A notification
PushType.description_zh:
推送类型。取值：

MESSAGE：消息。

NOTICE：通知

Source.description_en:
The source of the push. Valid values:

API: A push triggered by an OpenAPI call, including pushes from the OpenAPI console.

CONSOLE: A push triggered from the Mobile Push console
Source.description_zh:
推送源类型。可取值：

API：OpenAPI发起的推送，含OpenAPI平台控制台发起的推送。

CONSOLE：通过移动推送控制台推送

Status.description_en:
The status of the message. Valid values:

WAITING: The push is waiting to be sent.

SENT: The push has been sent.

CANCELED: The push has been canceled
Status.description_zh:
消息状态。可取值：

WAITING：等待中。

SENT：已推送。

CANCELED：已取消

Target.description_en:
The push target. Valid values:

ACCOUNT: Push to a specified account.

ALIAS: Push to a specified alias.

DEVICE: Push to a specified device.

TAG: Push to a specified tag.

ALL: Push to all devices.

TBD: Initializes a continuous push. The target is specified later by calling the `ContinuouslyPush` API operation

ACCOUNT：根据账号推送。

TAG：根据标签推送。

ALL：推送给全部设备。
